turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My gran gave me an orchid for my birthday and the leaves have gone all wrinkly.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Wrinkly leaves usually mean thirsty roots. Can you see the roots through the pot? Are they silvery grey or green?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait for me, I need to talk to Chloe about something. Don't say a word until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Have you seen my calculator? The graphing one.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Is it the grey one with the cracked screen?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes! Exam's at two and I can't find it anywhere.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I borrowed it on Tuesday, sorry. It's in my bag by the door.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You could have told me. I nearly bought a new one.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I know, I know. I'll buy you a coffee after your exam, deal?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. Back to your gran's orchid. Any luck spotting what colour the roots are?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then it's thirsty. Soak the whole pot in a bowl of room temperature water for ten minutes, then let it drain.
